title: Próximas entradas do índice — p. 101
scopeLimits: Este lote contém as entradas index-144–index-155. As demais linhas e o título permanecem em inglês até lotes próprios.
Referências e líderes sólidos permanecem iguais à fonte; o Viewer recompõe cada líder após o rótulo proposto.

Rounding Numbers, Side Quests, Simultaneous Abilities, Sphere of Influence, Spawning, Stamina Point(s), Standard Actions e Store ficam sinalizados para revisão humana onde a terminologia ou o sentido contextual não está decidido.
Scenes, Selling Items, Shop And Train, Skill Checks e Item reutilizam formas correntes ou aprovadas; isso não constitui aprovação editorial da página.

100%.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.
